newsitem.title: SPAIN: IBCA may cut Spain Endesa AA long-term debt.
newsitem.headline: IBCA may cut Spain Endesa AA long-term debt.

text.p: IBCA said it may cut Spanish electrical generator Endesa 's AA long-term debt rating after the company launched a friendly takeover bid on outstanding shares of its two associate distribution companies, Fecsa and Sevillana.
IBCA maintained Endesa's A1-plus short term rating.
IBCA said the cost of the takeover could amount to about 200 billion pesetas and will be funded from internal funds and long-term credit lines.
Endesa's total estimated debt at end-1996, forecast at about 552 billion pesetas, will more than double as a result of the consolidation of Fecsa and Sevillana, IBCA said.
Debt to equity will increase from 49 percent to about 112 percent, while debt payback periods could increase from 2.5 years to about 3.6 years, the agency said.
